create_solver_adam_anneal: create an Adam solver with temperature annealing for computing approximate Nash equilibria in nonsymmetric games
run_solver_descent_step: run the Adam descent step to update policy distributions and auxiliary variables using gradient updates
compute_gradients_solver: compute exploitability gradients and auxiliary variable gradients for all players in a nonsymmetric game
test_solver_exploitability: test the solver by computing Shannon entropy regularized exploitability of the current policy distribution
summarize_loss_gradients: summarize the loss_gradients function that computes projected exploitability gradients with entropy regularization
